name: Chris Kiri
source:
He seems to have a calm demeanor, but he talks with sharp words.
His hobby is chess and he has a weird habit of wanting to compare his pieces with others.
He sometimes appears in front of the protagonist and her team, sometimes when they're talking with him his personality completely changes.
